mapper.sql: WITH filtered_tasks AS ( SELECT t.task_id, t.task_type, t.task_stage, CASE UPPER(COALESCE(t.task_stage, 'FILE_PARSE')) WHEN 'EXTRACT' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'RAW_DATA_EXTRACT' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'PARSE' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'TASK_RAW_PARSED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'TASK_CREATED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'TASK_DISPATCHED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'TASK_EXECUTION_STARTED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'TASK_REUSED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'QUEUE_DISCOVERED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'QUEUE_GENERATED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'QUEUE_BACKFILLED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'QUEUE_REUSED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'QUEUE_UPDATED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'QUEUE_RETRIED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'QUEUE_SUBSCRIBED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'QUEUE_SUBSCRIBE_ATTEMPTED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'QUEUE_SUBSCRIBE_CONFLICT' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'QUEUE_SUBSCRIBE_SKIPPED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'QUEUE_FILE_INFO_REPAIR_STARTED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'QUEUE_FILE_INFO_REPAIR_COMPLETED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'QUEUE_FILE_INFO_REPAIR_FAILED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'TASK_STANDARDIZED' THEN 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE' WHEN 'STANDARDIZE' THEN 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE' WHEN 'TASK_PERSISTED' THEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' WHEN 'TASK_SUCCEEDED' THEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' WHEN 'QUEUE_COMPLETED' THEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' WHEN 'SUBJECT_RECOGNIZE' THEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' WHEN 'VERIFY_ARCHIVE' THEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' WHEN 'DATA_PROCESSING' THEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' ELSE UPPER(COALESCE(t.task_stage, 'FILE_PARSE')) END AS normalized_stage, t.task_status, t.business_key, t.file_id, t.task_start_time, CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(t.task_status, '')) IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'STOPPED', 'BLOCKED') THEN CASE UPPER(COALESCE(t.task_stage, 'FILE_PARSE')) WHEN 'FILE_PARSE' THEN DATE_ADD(t.task_start_time, INTERVAL COALESCE(t.parse_task_time_ms, 0) * 1000 MICROSECOND) WHEN 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE' THEN DATE_ADD(t.task_start_time, INTERVAL COALESCE(t.standardize_time_ms, 0) * 1000 MICROSECOND) WHEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' THEN DATE_ADD(t.task_start_time, INTERVAL COALESCE(t.match_standard_subject_time_ms, 0) * 1000 MICROSECOND) ELSE DATE_ADD(t.task_start_time, INTERVAL COALESCE(t.parse_task_time_ms, t.standardize_time_ms, t.match_standard_subject_time_ms, 0) * 1000 MICROSECOND) END ELSE NULL END AS task_end_time, t.parse_task_time_ms, t.standardize_time_ms, t.match_standard_subject_time_ms, CASE WHEN t.file_id IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT('FILE-', t.file_id) WHEN t.business_key IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(t.business_key) != '' THEN CONCAT( 'BIZ-', REPLACE( REPLACE( REPLACE(TRIM(t.business_key), ' ', '_'), ':', '_'), '/', '_') ) ELSE CONCAT('TASK-', t.task_id) END AS generated_batch_id, LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', COALESCE(t.business_key, ''), COALESCE(t.task_type, ''), COALESCE(t.task_stage, ''), COALESCE(t.task_status, ''), COALESCE(t.input_payload, ''), COALESCE(t.result_payload, ''), COALESCE(CAST(t.file_id AS CHAR), '') )) AS searchable_text FROM t_valset_workflow_task t WHERE t.task_type IN ('EXTRACT_DATA', 'PARSE_WORKBOOK') )

THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'QUEUE_SUBSCRIBE_SKIPPED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'QUEUE_FILE_INFO_REPAIR_STARTED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'QUEUE_FILE_INFO_REPAIR_COMPLETED' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN if.test: query != null and query.batchId != null and query.batchId != ''
query != null and query.managerName != null and query.managerName != ''
query != null and query.productKeyword != null and query.productKeyword != ''
query != null and query.stage != null and query.stage != ''
query != null and query.status != null and query.status != ''
query != null and query.sourceType != null and query.sourceType != ''
query != null and query.errorType != null and query.errorType != ''

when.test: query != null and query.taskDate != null and query.taskDate != ''

choose.when: AND ( ( ft.task_start_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{query.taskDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND ft.task_start_time < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{query.taskDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) OR ( ft.task_end_time IS NOT NULL AND ft.task_end_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{query.taskDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND ft.task_end_time < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{query.taskDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) )

when.test: query != null and query.businessDate != null and query.businessDate != ''

choose.when: AND ( ( ft.task_start_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{query.businessDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND ft.task_start_time < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{query.businessDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) OR ( ft.task_end_time IS NOT NULL AND ft.task_end_time >= STR_TO_DATE(#{query.businessDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND ft.task_end_time < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{query.businessDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ) )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount FROM filtered_tasks ft

SELECT ft.generated_batch_id AS batchId, COALESCE(ft.business_key, ft.generated_batch_id) AS batchName, DATE_FORMAT(ft.task_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS businessDate, NULL AS productCode, NULL AS productName, NULL AS managerName, CASE WHEN ft.file_id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(ft.file_id AS CHAR) END AS fileId, NULL AS filesysFileId, NULL AS originalFileName, ft.task_type AS sourceType, ft.normalized_stage AS currentStage, ft.normalized_stage AS currentStep, CASE ft.normalized_stage WHEN 'FILE_PARSE' THEN '文件解析' WHEN 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE' THEN '结构标准化' WHEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' THEN '标准表落地' ELSE '文件解析' END AS currentStageName, CASE ft.normalized_stage WHEN 'FILE_PARSE' THEN '文件解析' WHEN 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE' THEN '结构标准化' WHEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' THEN '标准表落地' ELSE '文件解析' END AS currentStepName, UPPER(COALESCE(ft.task_status, 'PENDING')) AS status, CASE UPPER(COALESCE(ft.task_status, 'PENDING')) WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN '处理中' WHEN 'SUCCESS' THEN '已完成' WHEN 'FAILED' THEN '失败' WHEN 'STOPPED' THEN '已停止' ELSE '待处理' END AS statusName, CASE UPPER(COALESCE(ft.task_status, 'PENDING')) WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN 50 WHEN 'SUCCESS' THEN 100 WHEN 'FAILED' THEN 66 WHEN 'STOPPED' THEN 0 ELSE 0 END AS progress, DATE_FORMAT(ft.task_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS startedAt, CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(ft.task_status, '')) IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'STOPPED') THEN DATE_FORMAT(ft.task_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') ELSE NULL END AS endedAt, CASE ft.normalized_stage WHEN 'FILE_PARSE' THEN ft.parse_task_time_ms WHEN 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE' THEN ft.standardize_time_ms WHEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' THEN ft.match_standard_subject_time_ms ELSE COALESCE(ft.parse_task_time_ms, ft.standardize_time_ms, ft.match_standard_subject_time_ms) END AS durationMs, NULL AS durationText, CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(ft.task_status, '')) IN ('FAILED', 'STOPPED', 'BLOCKED') THEN LEFT(COALESCE(ft.result_payload, ''), 1024) ELSE NULL END AS lastErrorMessage, CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(ft.task_status, '')) IN ('FAILED', 'STOPPED', 'BLOCKED') THEN UPPER(COALESCE(ft.task_status, '')) ELSE NULL END AS lastErrorCode FROM filtered_tasks ft
ORDER BY ft.task_start_time DESC, ft.task_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(ft.task_status, '')) = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS runningCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(ft.task_status, '')) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(ft.task_status, '')) = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failedCount FROM filtered_tasks ft
AND ( ft.generated_batch_id = #{query.batchId} OR ft.searchable_text LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query.batchId}), '%') )
AND ft.searchable_text LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query.managerName}), '%')
AND ft.searchable_text LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query.productKeyword}), '%')
AND ft.normalized_stage = UPPER(#{query.stage})
AND UPPER(COALESCE(ft.task_status, '')) = UPPER(#{query.status})
AND ft.searchable_text LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query.sourceType}), '%')
AND ft.searchable_text LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query.errorType}), '%')

SELECT stage, stage AS step, stageName, stageName AS stepName, stageDescription, stageDescription AS stepDescription, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(task_status, '')) = 'RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS runningCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(task_status, '')) = 'FAILED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(task_status, '')) IN ('PENDING', 'SCHEDULED', 'RETRYING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingCount FROM ( SELECT ft.task_status, ft.task_end_time, CASE ft.normalized_stage WHEN 'FILE_PARSE' THEN 'FILE_PARSE' WHEN 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE' THEN 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE' WHEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' THEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' ELSE 'FILE_PARSE' END AS stage, CASE ft.normalized_stage WHEN 'FILE_PARSE' THEN 1 WHEN 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE' THEN 2 WHEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' THEN 3 ELSE 99 END AS stageOrder, CASE ft.normalized_stage WHEN 'FILE_PARSE' THEN '文件解析' WHEN 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE' THEN '结构标准化' WHEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' THEN '标准表落地' ELSE '文件解析' END AS stageName, CASE ft.normalized_stage WHEN 'FILE_PARSE' THEN '解析 Spring Batch 文件输入与原始内容抽取结果' WHEN 'STRUCTURE_STANDARDIZE' THEN '查看字段映射、清洗和结构标准化执行状态' WHEN 'STANDARD_LANDING' THEN '查看标准表写入、落地和后续加工执行状态' ELSE '解析 Spring Batch 文件输入与原始内容抽取结果' END AS stageDescription FROM filtered_tasks ft
AND ( ft.generated_batch_id = #{query.batchId} OR ft.searchable_text LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query.batchId}), '%') )
AND ft.searchable_text LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query.managerName}), '%')
AND ft.searchable_text LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query.productKeyword}), '%')
AND ft.normalized_stage = UPPER(#{query.stage})
AND UPPER(COALESCE(ft.task_status, '')) = UPPER(#{query.status})
AND ft.searchable_text LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query.sourceType}), '%')
AND ft.searchable_text LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{query.errorType}), '%')
) stage_data GROUP BY stage, stageOrder, stageName, stageDescription ORDER BY stageOrder
